result.title: Text Is Just Another Shot in Vision-Language Models: Simple Probes on Frozen Encoders Do It
result.summary: Few-shot adaptation of vision-language models has produced increasingly elaborate methods built on CLIP and on one shared principle: the zero-shot text classifier is the anchor, and labeled images only correct it. We argue that this principle reflects CLIP's visual features rather than a property of the task. We provide a simple Bayesian interpretation, in which a class name is worth exactly kappa = sigma^2 / tau^2 labeled images, the ratio between the visual spread of a class and the misalignment of its name. The Bayes classifier of this model counts text as kappa more samples. With modern frozen encoders, few-shot adaptation then reduces to a well-regularised convex probe. Specifically, we introduce TASP, a simple convex logistic regression on frozen features that incorporates class-name embeddings as weighted training examples and as a regularization prior. On the standard 11-dataset benchmark, TASP with frozen PE-Core-L features achieves 87.1% accuracy at 1 shot and 91.4% at 16 shots, outperforming state-of-the-art few-shot vision-language adaptation methods by 4.6 to 11.0 percentage points. While stronger representations explain much of this improvement, controlled comparisons on matched features show that existing frozen-encoder adaptation methods do not materially improve on this probe. We further find that the weight assigned to text matters more than how it is incorporated, and that combining self-supervised visual features with vision-language representations is most beneficial for weaker visual encoders. Together, these findings suggest that progress in few-shot vision-language adaptation depends more on representation quality and the appropriate use of text supervision than on increasingly complex adaptation mechanisms.

AI.brief_summary: 该文把少样本视觉语言适配重新解释为贝叶斯问题，提出在冻结特征上做凸逻辑回归的 TASP，将类名嵌入作为加权样本与正则先验，并在 11 个数据集基准上取得领先准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是少样本图像分类的适配方法，不涉及推理期 latent 状态、视觉证据筛选或停止决策；「表征质量比适配机制更关键」仅是泛化结论，未提供可供 LVR 核查的具体机制线索。
